headline: Leakage-controlled benchmarks and embedding tools for protein and antibody prediction
label: Leakage Aware Computational Protein Tools
summary: Recent preprints and papers pair structure- and embedding-based predictors with leakage-aware validation to guard against overstated performance.
synthesis: The common thread across these items is evaluation design for computational predictors of protein function and antibody properties. SABLE provides a versioned structural antibody benchmark with a fixed training set and a leakage-controlled test set stratified by similarity, while the Foldseek study applies a time-split benchmark to structural homology transfer for domains of unknown function across four model proteomes. The VHH study uses cluster-aware cross-validation for polyreactivity models, and FANTASIA pairs embedding-based annotation with leakage-aware configuration in a reproducible framework. On the tooling side, GOlien offers a composition-based k-mer Shannon-entropy approach to GO term prediction, and SixPack-AbScan provides a web server for cross-species antibody epitope conservation screening. The notable feature is that split design is treated as a reported component of the method rather than an afterthought, although the items differ in scope, from sequence composition to antibody epitope screening.
